leading.name: Leading and deciding
leading.examples: leading a meeting, making final decisions
leading.best_text: [name] makes decisions with confidence and keeps things moving.
leading.also_text: [name] brings energy and gets people excited to follow the plan.
leading.extra_text: They also tend to stay calm under pressure.

presenting.name: Presenting and talking to people
presenting.best_text: [name] enjoys talking to people and can make any topic sound interesting.
presenting.also_text: [name] speaks with confidence and gets straight to the point.
presenting.extra_text: They also get energy from being around people.

ideas.name: Coming up with ideas
ideas.best_text: [name] is full of ideas and loves thinking of new possibilities.
ideas.also_text: [name] likes new challenges and isn't afraid to try something different.
ideas.extra_text: They also enjoy creative ways of doing things.

helping.name: Helping and informing team members and customers
helping.examples: keeping everyone updated, helping new members, handling questions from customers or users
helping.best_text: [name] is patient and a good listener, so people feel comfortable asking them for help.
helping.also_text: [name] is friendly and enjoys keeping everyone updated.
helping.extra_text: They also care a lot about how others feel.

planning.name: Planning and organising
planning.examples: making schedules, keeping track of deadlines
planning.best_text: [name] thinks ahead and likes things to be clear and well organised.
planning.also_text: [name] is steady and reliable, so plans stay on track.
planning.extra_text: They also like to finish what they start.

checking.name: Checking details
checking.examples: proofreading, testing, checking numbers or quality
checking.best_text: [name] notices small details that others might miss.
checking.also_text: [name] is patient and careful, and doesn't rush through things.
checking.extra_text: They also care about getting things right.
